input.prompt:
Motion contract: Camera: tracks steady with the subject toward screen right (background flows toward screen left). Moderate amplitude, spread evenly over the full 7 seconds. Subjects: subject 1: "sprints at full speed toward the ventilation shaft" — a large, clearly visible movement that completes fully. Pace the motion across the full 7-second duration — by the final frame every scripted movement has fully completed. Do NOT add any camera movement, framing change, new character, new prop or extra action beyond this contract.. The girl sprints at full speed toward a narrow, rust-covered ventilation shaft passage.

Camera choreography, one move: this shot has exactly one camera move — a steady side-on lateral track that follows the girl as she runs toward screen right. The camera starts head-on in front of her at chest height, looking back down the corridor at her with the doorway she has just cleared behind her shoulders, then settles into a full side-on profile at her right and holds it for the rest of the shot. First she faces the lens; then she is running toward screen right in profile and the camera travels laterally alongside her at her own running speed, keeping her the same size in the middle of the frame while the corridor walls and pillars stream from screen right to screen left. Once it is side-on nothing else changes — no push-in, no orbit, no crane, no change of height, distance or roll — and the lateral track continues unbroken through the final frame.
